extracted.intended_audience: researchers conducting systematic reviews in agriculture/soil science (Portuguese-speaking); authors preparing PRISMA-based review protocols
extracted.subtask_description: A PRISMA-based systematic review protocol examining silicate rock powders as nutrient sources for cultivated plants; preregistered on OSF. The page is an Internet Archive mirror of an OSF registration describing the planned literature review and its objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adesão às recomendações PRISMA
rubrics_metrics.description: "recomendações do anagrama PRISMA." (the study is a systematic literature review with the recommendations of the PRISMA acronym).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The protocol declares use of PRISMA reporting/review recommendations; reviewers should expect a PRISMA checklist, transparent reporting of search, selection, extraction, and synthesis steps. (The page itself does not list the checklist items.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Revisão sistemática da literatura (metodologia)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Trata-se de uma revisão sistemática da literatura" — the study is presented as a systematic literature review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied methodological expectations: a defined search strategy, explicit inclusion/exclusion criteria, reproducible study selection and data extraction procedures, and systematic synthesis of findings. The page gives no detailed methods but frames the work as a systematic review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Objetivo: apresentar o estado da arte sobre o uso de pós de rocha silicática
rubrics_metrics.description: "O presente estudo tem por objetivo apresentar o estado da arte sobre o uso de pós de rocha silicática como fonte de nutrientes para plantas cultivadas."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quality/evaluation should consider how comprehensively and clearly the review synthesizes current evidence on silicate rock powders as nutrient sources for cultivated plants, including scope, depth, balance of evidence, and identification of gaps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registro e transparência (OSF preregistration)
rubrics_metrics.description: Metadata fields: Osf_registration_doi 10.17605/OSF.IO/6FR9G; Osf_registry: OSF Registries; Osf_project link provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The work is preregistered on OSF; this implies pre-specification of objectives/methods. Reviewers should check the registration for protocol details and deviations from the registered plan to assess risk of bias and selective reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Licença e disponibilização aberta
rubrics_metrics.description: License: http://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.txt (item is released under LGPL-3.0 as shown).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expectation of open access / reuse-permitting license for materials; reviewers and users should verify availability of full protocol, data, and materials under the stated license for reproducibility and reuse.
